description: Kajabi Knowledge Commerce Platform - Manage online courses, memberships, coaching programs, and digital products

tools.name: kajabi_list_products
tools.short_description: List Kajabi products - courses, memberships, coaching with ID, name, type, pricing
tools.description: List all products (courses, memberships, coaching programs). Returns product details including ID, name, type, and pricing.

type.description: Filter by product type: 'course', 'membership', 'coaching', or null for all

returns.description: List of products with pagination info

tools.name: kajabi_get_product
tools.short_description: Get Kajabi product details by ID - offerings, pricing, content, full specs
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific product by ID. Returns complete product details including offerings, pricing, and content.

tools.name: kajabi_list_offers
tools.short_description: List Kajabi payment offers - pricing plans, payment options, product links
tools.description: List all offers (payment plans). Returns offer details including pricing, payment options, and product associations.

returns.description: List of offers with pagination info

tools.name: kajabi_get_offer
tools.short_description: Get Kajabi offer by ID - pricing details, payment plans, availability
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific offer by ID. Returns pricing, payment plans, and availability.

tools.name: kajabi_list_members
tools.short_description: List Kajabi members/students - email, status, product access, filter by status
tools.description: List all members (customers/students). Returns member details including email, status, and product access.

returns.description: List of members with pagination info

tools.name: kajabi_get_member
tools.short_description: Get Kajabi member by ID - profile, subscriptions, product access details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific member by ID. Returns member profile, subscriptions, and product access.

tools.name: kajabi_search_members
tools.short_description: Search Kajabi members by email, name, custom fields - find matching profiles
tools.description: Search members by email, name, or custom fields. Returns matching member profiles.

tools.name: kajabi_grant_product_access
tools.short_description: Grant Kajabi member access to product - manual enrollment, promotions
tools.description: Grant a member access to a specific product. Used for manual enrollments or promotions.

offer_id.description: Optional offer ID to use for enrollment

tools.name: kajabi_revoke_product_access
tools.short_description: Revoke Kajabi member product access - cancellations, suspensions
tools.description: Revoke a member's access to a specific product. Used for cancellations or suspensions.

tools.name: kajabi_list_webhooks
tools.short_description: List Kajabi webhooks - URLs, event subscriptions, active status
tools.description: List all configured webhooks. Returns webhook URLs, events, and status.

returns.description: List of webhooks with pagination info

tools.name: kajabi_create_webhook
tools.short_description: Create Kajabi webhook - real-time events, configure URL and event triggers
tools.description: Create a new webhook to receive real-time events. Configure URL and events to monitor.

url.description: Webhook URL to receive POST requests

tools.name: kajabi_delete_webhook
tools.short_description: Delete Kajabi webhook by ID - stop receiving events to URL
tools.description: Delete a webhook by ID. Stops receiving events to the specified URL.

tools.name: kajabi_list_form_submissions
tools.short_description: List Kajabi form submissions - opt-ins, contact forms with timestamps
tools.description: List form submissions (opt-ins, contact forms). Returns submission data and timestamps.

start_date.description: Filter submissions after this date (ISO 8601 format)

end_date.description: Filter submissions before this date (ISO 8601 format)

returns.description: List of form submissions with pagination

tools.name: kajabi_get_form_submission
tools.short_description: Get Kajabi form submission by ID - detailed submission data
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific form submission by ID.

tools.name: kajabi_get_site_details
tools.short_description: Get Kajabi site details - account info, site name, domain, configuration
tools.description: Get details about the Kajabi site (account info). Returns site name, domain, and configuration.

tools.name: kajabi_list_tags
tools.short_description: List Kajabi member tags - tag names with usage counts for segmentation
tools.description: List all member tags. Returns tag names and usage counts.

returns.description: List of tags with usage stats

tools.name: kajabi_add_member_tag
tools.short_description: Add tag to Kajabi member - segmentation, automation triggers
tools.description: Add a tag to a member. Used for segmentation and automation triggers.

tools.name: kajabi_remove_member_tag
tools.short_description: Remove tag from Kajabi member - update segmentation
tools.description: Remove a tag from a member. Updates member segmentation.
